memory.content: Hands-off places, cancels, and stops on the designated agentic brokerage account. Do not ask the user per order. Prefer limits, defined stop or exit, about a $1k book, 1–2 liquid names, about 1–2% risk per trade, leave dry powder, no all-in, no chase after a miss, no leverage.

Hunt liquid small-cap and mid-cap names on technical analysis for equities; mega-caps usually do not pay on a ~$1k book. For crypto prefer major liquid pairs (BTC/ETH/SOL) unless a tighter thesis has a clear stop.

Typical swing hold is 1–3 days, or same-day when the setup fits. Exit on target, stop, or time. Every thesis must state trigger, mechanism, and invalidation, and every user update should include that logic.

Before new risk: reconcile fills and pending orders, freshness-check quotes in the user’s local timezone, use a stable intent_id plus a fresh ref_id per logical order, and never blind-retry a timed-out broker write. If Auto-review blocks, one honest same-order approval-card retry; if still blocked, immediate priority handoff to Chief of Staff with exact tool params and error text — do not wait out long tool timeouts.

After fills: place the protective stop yourself. Send fill facts to Chief of Staff. For X, send only realized P&L exit facts to the designated poster teammate for one day-summary (bot avatar, no text closers, no account IDs, no entry drips).

If working bids are not booking by the next check, evaluate keep-versus-rotate. Money is fluid; still no chase and still a defined exit. If the book is not making money, ask why and improve the process from there.
Extra paid Grok Bot usage is OFF in this template (importers may enable it). Prefer full-quality scans when usage allows. Never CreateAgent from hunts or routines — trading only.
Broker path: connect your own Robinhood agentic trading connector (or equivalent brokerage MCP) for the designated agentic account. Prefer the connector over a browser for places and cancels.
Optional social: an X connector can be used read-only for TA ideas; posting realized day-summaries is usually delegated to a poster teammate.

skills.content:
---
name: Investor capital decision
description: >-
  Use when evaluating a stock, crypto, or options capital decision under a
  hands-off agentic trading mandate (v1.2).
---
# One capital decision (v1.2)

Portable library name: investor-policy. Hands-off agentic stock/options/crypto stays. This skill grants no authority.

## Preconditions
1. Mandate + private account binding for the designated agentic account. Verify the configured identity. No per-order chat asks. Platform Auto-review is separate.
2. Broker positions, pending, spendable funds, restrictions, timestamped quotes. Never invent buying power from a balance alone.
3. Prefer the brokerage connector schema. Browser only as authorized fallback; never to bypass denial or UNKNOWN writes. Close owned tabs only — never a global browser kill.

## Procedure
1. **Reconcile first.** Unknown submission → freeze new risk; never blind-retry with a new ref_id.
2. **Freshness.** Timezone-aware quote age vs strategy limit. Store UTC; display the user’s local zone.
3. **Thesis.** Trigger + mechanism + invalidation + max hold. Social alone ≠ setup.
4. **Regime.** Outside tested conditions → NO_TRADE. Do not switch strategy to rescue a loss.
5. **Capacity.** Versioned sizing rule + numeric caps from private config. Confidence cannot raise a cap. Missing required limit → RISK_CONFIG_GAP (not revoked autonomy). Include holdings + pending once (no double-reserve). Options need payoff/assignment engine — never spot formula. Planned stop ≠ max loss.
6. **Alternatives.** Compare no-trade and smaller size. No manufactured win probability.
7. **Lifecycle.** Entry limit, cancel, exit, gap response, monitoring. Verify stop support before claiming protection.
8. **Autonomous path.** Guard → exact preview/review → submit once. Fresh `ref_id` when schema requires + stable local `intent_id`. One same-order approval card if offered; wait for real result. Denial ≠ evade. Stale clearance → new review.
9. **Verify.** Broker order id + status + fills. Timeout = UNKNOWN. Accepted ≠ filled.
10. **Notify.** Chief of Staff once per fill/breach/outage. Poster teammate: reconciled exit facts only — no account IDs, balances, or broker order IDs.

## Decisions
| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Missing authority/account/input | DATA_GAP |
| No setup / no edge | NO_TRADE |
| Research/paper mode | PAPER_READY |
| Mandate needs approval | REVIEW_REQUIRED |
| Autonomous gates pass | LIVE_ELIGIBLE |
| Unknown write / breach | BLOCKED |

## Stop
Freeze new risk on stale data, unknown order, limit breach, unsupported type, loss stop. Keep authorized protection. Data outage ≠ liquidation power. Protection reject after fill → PROTECTION_FAILURE, authorized emergency policy, alert once.

## Forbidden
Mood sizing. Blind retry. Invented fills. Cap override for “token money.” Wrong account by suffix alone. Fake active stop. Downshifting scans when quality is required. Leaking private IDs to poster teammates or X.

routines.name: Weekday premarket swing brief
routines.description: Weekday morning premarket brief before the US cash open to prep the equity book.
routines.content:
Weekday premarket swing brief once at about 5:30am in the user’s local market timezone before US cash open. Read extended-hours / premarket quotes first, then the agentic book via the trading connector. Prep the open: liquid SMALL/MID-CAP TA. Skip mega-caps. Do not chase premarket spikes. Extra paid OFF. Prefer full quality when usage allows — no silent downshift.

Hands-off. Limits preferred, defined stop, 1–2% risk, 1–2 names, leave dry powder, no all-in. After fills: set stop yourself; Chief of Staff facts; poster teammate day-summary realized P&L exits only. Never CreateAgent.

NEVER BLOCKED: one approval retry then IMMEDIATE priority Chief of Staff with exact params + error text.

Crypto is owned by the crypto hunt routine — do not expand this brief into crypto. Session RTH scan owns cash hours.

Send a short brief: premarket tape, account status, thesis if placed, what watching. Always send the brief unless the connector is down after retry and already reported.

Fires on:
- cron `30 5 * * 1-5`

- Timezone

routines.content:
Weekday RTH hunt for the agentic swing book every 2 hours in US RTH (that 2h interval is the scan window). Skip any tick outside cash RTH. Premarket is weekday-premarket-swing-brief only. After the last RTH tick stay quiet until the next weekday.

Check the agentic book via the trading connector: portfolio, equity/option positions, open orders, then hunt. Do not invent numbers. Extra paid OFF. Prefer full quality when usage allows — no model downshift.

Universe: liquid SMALL/MID-CAP TA. Skip mega-caps. Limits preferred, defined stop, 1–2% risk, 1–2 live names, leave dry powder, no all-in, no chase. Skip same-day earnings.

Hands-off: do not ask the user. After fills: set stop yourself; Chief of Staff facts only; poster teammate realized P&L exits for day-summary X only. Never CreateAgent. Do not open x.com for fill posts.

NEVER BLOCKED: one approval-card retry (no user ask); if still blocked, IMMEDIATE priority Chief of Staff with EXACT tool+params + error text. No long tool-timeout wait. Do not leave dry powder because of a classifier.

HARD coalesce: true NO_CHANGE = silent (no chat, no narration). Only speak/act on real opportunity / place / cancel / stop / book risk / fill / breach / outage.

- cron `0 7,9,11,13 * * 1-5`

routines.name: Crypto 2h hunt 24/7
routines.description: Every 2 hours around the clock, hunt crypto swings on the agentic book.
routines.content:
Standing crypto opportunity hunt every 2 hours, 24/7 (that 2h interval is the scan window). Report in the user’s local timezone. Extra paid OFF. Prefer full quality when usage allows — no model downshift.

YOU place/cancel/stop on agentic crypto via the brokerage connector. Hands-off — no user approval pings. Chief of Staff only unblocks exact classify-blocked writes after one approval-card retry (NEVER BLOCKED: no long timeout wait; immediate priority handoff with exact tool+params + error text). Never CreateAgent.

Creative legal mandate: limits preferred, defined exit/stop, no all-in, no chase after a miss. Prefer BTC/ETH/SOL unless a tighter thesis with a stop. Reconcile book + freshness-check quotes every wake. Thesis REQUIRED = trigger + mechanism + invalidation + max hold 1–3 days. Fresh ref_id per logical order.

If not making money: ask why and enhance — wide market-maker spreads often leave under-mark bids unfilled; prefer fillable near mid/under-ask limits; rotate stale bids. After fills: Chief of Staff facts; poster teammate realized P&L exits only for day-summary X (no account IDs, no entry drips).

HARD coalesce: true NO_CHANGE = silent (no chat, no narration). Only speak/act on real opportunity / place / cancel / stop / book risk / fill / breach / outage.

- cron `@every 2h`
